item.title: Zip Loved The Sunny Day
item.description: Yesterday the temperature shot up to 70 degrees; today it’s back down in the 30s. We’re not quite done with winter. Zip loved it; he took his nap right outside the barn and paid no attention to us. I don’t often see him still. We’re off to pick up Maria’s wool. See you later. The post Zip Loved The Sunny Day appeared first on Bedlam Farm.
